facts.text: A family-owned private estate in Oak Glen, hosting one event per day in an open-air venue
Owners: Don and Paula Christante
More than a hundred years ago Blackie Wilshire and his family made the glen their home; pieces of the original homestead still stand
5.5 acres in Oak Glen, beneath Wilshire Peak and the San Bernardino Mountains
Oaks, sycamores, heirloom apple trees and a lilac field; the property overlooks the valley below
The original feel of the family ranch is preserved, with modern amenities added
Open-air ceremony site under oak and sycamore trees, built for a grand entrance and leading to a terraced stage
Guests dine outdoors with mountain views and dance under string lights and stars
A handcrafted self-serve beverage station sits between the ceremony and reception spaces
A fire pit for gathering and s'mores in the evening
Gas and electric lamps and strings of café lights light the evening
The Cottage and the Cabin are private getting-ready spaces with a refrigerator, ice and a microwave
Modern restrooms, full ADA access, room for RVs, a designated outdoor smoking lounge and lit on-site parking
All-inclusive weddings: staff and in-house vendors plan, prepare and produce; in-house coordination, set-up and clean-up, rehearsal and a large décor collection
Packages: WeekDay Essentials, WeekEnd Essentials and All-Inclusive Premier (2027 PDFs)
Only one wedding per day; a private estate not open to the public
Comfortably accommodates a maximum of about 180 guests
Outside vendors are welcome, to add to or replace package vendors, with no extra fee
Tax included in all pricing; no service, administrative or corkage fees
Non-refundable deposit holds the date; signed contract within 3 weeks; thirds due 210, 150 and 60 days before the event
Oak Glen sits at 4,734 ft and is usually about 10 degrees cooler than inland cities
Tours by appointment only
The Knot Best of Weddings 2024 (badge on the homepage)

story.lead: A family ranch in Oak Glen, kept the way it always felt.
paragraphs: More than a hundred years ago Blackie Wilshire and his family made this glen their home, and pieces of the original homestead still stand on the property.

Owners Don and Paula Christante have kept the feel of the family ranch and added modern comforts. The 5.5 acres sit under Wilshire Peak and the San Bernardino Mountains, among oaks, sycamores, heirloom apple trees and a lilac field, looking over the valley below.

timeline.text: Blackie Wilshire and his family make the glen their home.
One wedding a day on 5.5 acres.

spaces.name: The Ceremony Area
spaces.blurb: Under the spreading arms of old oaks and sycamores: a long aisle built for a grand entrance, ending at a terraced stage.

spaces.name: The Reception Area
spaces.blurb: Dinner outdoors with the mountains in view, then dancing under string lights and stars, with the fire pit nearby for s'mores.

spaces.name: The Beverage Area
spaces.blurb: A handcrafted, self-serve beverage station set between the ceremony and the reception.

spaces.name: The Cottage & Cabin
spaces.blurb: Two private getting-ready spaces, one for each party, far enough for a quiet moment and close to the celebration. Refrigerator, ice and microwave inside.

faqs.q: How many weddings do you host per day?
faqs.a: Only one. The HomeStead is a private estate and is not open to the public.

faqs.q: How many guests can you host?

faqs.a: Yes, to add to the package or replace one of the preferred vendors, with no extra fee.
No. Tax is included in all pricing, and there are no service, administrative or corkage fees.

faqs.q: Can we bring our own DJ?

faqs.a: It is an outdoor venue with room for a 40 by 60 ft tent, rented through the house or on your own. Whether to tent is your call.
No earlier than 30 minutes before the ceremony starts.

faqs.q: Can our dog be in the wedding?

faqs.a: A non-refundable deposit holds your date and a signed contract is due within three weeks. The balance is paid in thirds, 210, 150 and 60 days before the event; other schedules can be discussed.
A layer. Oak Glen sits at 4,734 ft and is usually about 10 degrees cooler than inland cities: a sweater for May or June evenings, a jacket for fall. There are no gas stations in Oak Glen.
Tours are by appointment only. Download the wedding pricing pamphlet first, then call or email.
